traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This report covers two protocols (① paired study, same enrichment; ② unpaired study, different enrichment) and, within protocol ①, two readings (22h and 48h). I selected Table 8 (Protocol ①, Reading 22h) as the primary/canonical method-comparison table since it is the first and most complete category breakdown (799 samples, all six ISO 16140-2 categories) and reading 22h is the standard alternative-method reading time. Protocol ① Reading 48h results (Table 9) and Protocol ② Reading 22h+48h results (Table 10), plus the combined summary (Table 11), are alternative variants not included here. The interlaboratory study (section 3.3, Tables 30-32) gives an overall SE/RT/FPR of 100% but is not broken down by food category, so it was not used. Total/aggregate rows for each table (e.g., 'Total protocol ① 22h') were excluded per instructions, as were 'Total Meat products' etc. subtotal rows, since only the individual type-level rows within each category are aggregated into the category itself in the source table (M1/M2/M3 rolled into 'Total Meat products' which is the category-level entry used here).
